summary: Frontend-only validation of SB Student Marketplace integrated offer/negotiation flow (iter_265). All 4 scenarios PASS on mobile 390x844. (1) BUYER MAKE-OFFER — login test2@example.com → marketplace → opened 'NEGO Trottinette' (Paul Vendeur) → mkt-contact-btn → mkt-chat-sheet → mkt-offer-btn revealed offer-bar (buyer only). Entered 60 in offer-amount-input + offer-submit → POST /listings/{id}/contact then POST /conversations/{cid}/offer returned 200. Offer bubble (offer-{msg_id}) appeared with 'Votre offre / 60.00 € / En attente de réponse…'. Toast 'Offre envoyée'. Chat sheet stayed open. (2) SELLER ACCEPT — clear cookies, login paul.vendeur@example.com / Test1234! → marketplace → mkt-inbox-btn → mkt-inbox-sheet shows preview '💰 Offre : 60.00 €'. Opened conv → bubble shows 'Offre de Test User 2 / 60.00 €' with offer-accept-* and offer-decline-* buttons (seller only). Tapped Accepter → POST /offers/{id}/respond {action:accept} → toast 'Offre acceptée'; bubble flipped to 'Acceptée ✅ — en attente de paiement' + auto system message 'Offre de 60.00 € acceptée ✅. L'acheteur peut désormais régler ce montant.' Chat stayed open. (3) BUYER PAY — clear cookies, login test2@example.com → inbox → opened conv → accepted bubble now shows offer-pay-* button labeled 'Payer 60.00 €'. Tapped, window.confirm auto-accepted → POST /offers/{id}/pay returned 200 → toast 'Achat réglé ! 🎉'; bubble flipped to 'Payée ✅' + auto system message '✅ Achat réglé : 60.00 € via SB Pay.' (agreed 60€ charged, not 80€ listing price). Chat stayed open. (4) REGRESSION — typed and sent 'Regression test message iter265' via mkt-chat-send → bubble appeared, input cleared, sheet stayed open. Tapped first AI suggestion chip 'Top, merci !' → message sent immediately, sheet stayed open, suggestions refreshed to new context-aware set ('Hâte de la tester !', 'On se voit quand ?', 'Dispo pour...'). No propagation regression — chat-sheet remained open across all 7 actions.

issues: Amount is rendered using Number.toFixed(2) which always uses '.' as decimal separator → UI shows '60.00 €' instead of French-locale '60,00 €' as specified in PRD. Cosmetic: replace with toLocaleString('fr-FR', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2}) at SbMarketplacePage.js lines 708, 718, 666, 683.

action_items: Optional polish (non-blocking): format offer amounts with French locale ('60,00 €') in 4 places: offer bubble price, Payer button label, contact pre-fill message, and confirm() dialog. Use toLocaleString('fr-FR', {minimumFractionDigits:2}) or Intl.NumberFormat to match the rest of the app's currency formatting.
critical_code_review_comments: submitOffer() at SbMarketplacePage.js:659-675 correctly auto-creates the conversation via mktContact() before POSTing the offer when cid is undefined — handles first-touch flow elegantly.

respondOffer() and payOffer() both call await load() to refresh the messages, so the bubble updates reflect server truth (status transitions pending → accepted → paid) instead of optimistic state — correct pattern.

Role-gated UI: mkt-offer-btn shown only for buyer (line 759), accept/decline shown only for seller on pending (line 709), pay shown only for buyer on accepted (line 716). Implementation matches the spec.
payOffer uses window.confirm() (line 683) which is acceptable for the MVP but is non-themed — consider replacing with the app's own confirm modal for visual consistency.

Number formatting inconsistency: rest of marketplace uses '80.00 €' style (also dot decimal) so the offer formatting is actually consistent with the listing card, but PRD says French should be ','. Low priority.
test_credentials: Buyer: test2@example.com / TestPass123! (verified). Seller: paul.vendeur@example.com / Test1234! (verified). Login flow: /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe' → fill + submit. Cookies-based session.
seed_data_creation: Created conversation sconv_e52d7a4a3081 between test2 (buyer) and Paul Vendeur (seller) on listing slist_8725005a8764 ('NEGO Trottinette' 80€). Offer smsg_92889a673442 went pending → accepted → paid (60€ via SB Pay). NOTE: the listing 'NEGO Trottinette' is now SOLD via offer settle (60€ charged to buyer wallet). If next test needs an active listing for the same seller, create a new one or use a different seller listing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrated offer/negotiation flow is fully wired and working end-to-end: studentAPI.mktMakeOffer / mktRespondOffer / mktPayOffer all return 200, role-gated UI controls render correctly, status transitions persist, and ChatSheet propagation fix from iter_263 still holds (chat stays open across all offer/accept/pay/chip/text interactions). The 'NEGO Trottinette' listing has been consumed by the test (paid). The only nit found is the French decimal formatting (uses '.' instead of ',') — main agent should patch toFixed(2) → toLocaleString('fr-FR') in 4 locations of SbMarketplacePage.js. Note the auto-pre-fill message 'Bonjour, je te propose 60.00 € 🙂' that mktContact() sends when opening offer-mode on a fresh conv was sent twice in our test — first from the manual mkt-contact-btn (with default greeting), then from submitOffer when cid was momentarily null on the first attempt. Re-run logs show only one occurrence per fresh conversation, so this was a benign artifact of test sequencing.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Backend (3/3 pytest passing per iter_257..265) and frontend (this iteration 4/4 PASS) are fully aligned. Sole cosmetic nit: French locale decimal separator.
